items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He's sort of like Bach and Handel did at the end of the growth period

ctx.x: Cause he did so much so early, Very eclectic (inaudible). He's sort of like Bach and Handel did at the end of the growth period, just sort of brought it together and culminated it. And, after that, you know, as you go into other directions but there isn't too much to do. So, he was sort of like, I would imagine, one of those that just sort of drew that whole, what is it, horizontal aspect of (inaudible) and leading into the lineal thing that was going to come.
